description: Look up the result Knox sealed when an agent's job came back, by its return stamp code. No key needed. The answer gives LINES_UP or MISMATCH, the kinds of difference found, when it was sealed, and the Bitcoin status of its hourly batch. What it does not show: the compare sets the agent's report beside the owner's own log, not beside what the outside system did, and it is only as complete as that record. agentIdentity "proven" means the job was signed with a key enrolled under the owner's Knox key; it does not say who owns the agent. stoppedByBank means an enrolled key signed a stop; it does not say which person signed it. For a job whose owner asked for it at the start, the answer also carries knoxRecord, knoxAllows, knoxAllowsHash and witnesses: the owner's own log and the agent's report were then also compared with the yes answers Knox itself gave. A job that did not ask carries none of these.

hash.description: The return stamp code (64 hex characters).

trip_id.description: The job id set when the job started.
